rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for something impressive, excellent, or formidable.

example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 bo1 zan1 hai6 ging6

rows.note: Use this when the thing is awe-inspiring or emotionally powerful, not merely large or good.

example.english: The ending of this documentary is tremendous.
example.traditional: 呢套紀錄片嘅結局好震撼。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 ge3 git3 guk6 hou2 zan3 ham6

rows.note: Use this for a very large amount, extent, degree, or scale rather than for general admiration.

example.english: The expense of this project is tremendous.
example.traditional: 今次個工程嘅開支好大。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gung1 cing4 ge3 hoi1 zi1 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Choose this when the size, achievement, or impact is strikingly astonishing.

example.english: The amount of donations they raised this time is tremendous.
example.traditional: 佢哋今次籌到嘅善款數目驚人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gam1 ci3 cau4 dou2 ge3 sin6 fun2 sou3 muk6 ging1 jan4
